generation.walk: Existing three-frame strips were extracted with wide gutters and arranged as contact, down, passing pairs. Up frames 04-06 are horizontal flops of 01-03 so the opposite diagonal pair leads in the second half.
generation.idle: The existing three-view sitting sheet supplies front, back, and left sitting poses with tucked paws and curled tails.
generation.anchorMethod: Every source was measured against the shared model-sheet standing anchor, then resized once with the factor below. No source was upscaled.

postProcessing.extract: extract-strip.ts with full connected-component bounds and expected=3
postProcessing.uniformScale: Scale is selected from the shared standing anchor; posture changes determine seated height naturally.
postProcessing.despill: postprocess.ts green despill, then atlas packing
postProcessing.upCycle: magick -flop applied to up_walk_01..03 to produce up_walk_04..06 before packing
postProcessing.atlas: pack-atlas.ts, five columns, PixiJS v8 animation names

validator: Mandatory exact animation set, clearance, components, spill, baseline, ink-aware edges, walk area ratio, idle area ratio, blockiness, and down/up mirror IoU checks.
selectionReason: The selected sources preserve the approved orange/cream markings, blue collar, yellow star tag, pink features, cream-tipped tail, clean head-on front/back views, and left-facing side gait.
